Documentation.long_help: Join disconnected regions of vtkPolyData at their closest vertices when that gap is at most Fuse Threshold. Fuse Method is Average (midpoint), Snap small to large (keep the larger region's vertex), or Construct primitives (keep all points; add a line or two triangles at the gap). Raising the threshold does not move welds that already passed. Fuse Verts / Lines / Polys choose which cell arrays are written.
Documentation.short_help: SHYX Disconnected Region Fuse: Fuse nearby vertices across disconnected verts/lines/polys.

InputProperty.name: Input
InputProperty.Documentation: PolyData to fuse. With Fuse Within Input on, disconnected pieces in one dataset are separate regions. Additional pipeline nodes can be added as extra connections on port 0 (Add, do not Set).

DoubleVectorProperty.name: FuseThreshold
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Fuse Threshold
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Distance threshold: each pair of disconnected regions is joined only at their closest vertices, and only if that gap is at most this value. Raising the threshold does not move welds that already passed; it only allows farther region pairs to join. Lowering it below a gap breaks that join.

IntVectorProperty.name: FuseWithinInput
IntVectorProperty.label: Fuse Within Input
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: On: disconnected pieces inside one input are separate fuse regions (a single dataset of broken lines/surfaces can weld). Off: each input connection is one region; pieces inside that connection are never merged.

IntVectorProperty.name: FusePositionMode
IntVectorProperty.label: Fuse Method
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: How regions are joined at the closest gap. Average: merge the two vertices at their midpoint. Snap small to large: merge onto the larger region's vertex (size is point count). Construct primitives: do not merge or delete points; add a line between line endpoints, or two triangles that zip the nearest incident edges of two surfaces (quad split on the shorter diagonal). If a face bridge cannot be built, a line is added instead. Output cell array SHYXFuseMark is 0 unchanged, 1 original cell incident to a fused vertex, 2 newly constructed primitive.

IntVectorProperty.name: FuseVerts
IntVectorProperty.label: Fuse Verts
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Remap vertex cells (vtkVertex / vtkPolyVertex) onto fused points and keep them in the output. Off drops verts. Degenerate vertex cells with no remaining points are discarded.

IntVectorProperty.name: FuseLines
IntVectorProperty.label: Fuse Lines
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Remap line cells (vtkLine / vtkPolyLine) onto fused points and keep them in the output. Nearby endpoints from different connected pieces share a vertex after fusion. Off drops lines. Degenerate lines with fewer than 2 points are discarded.

IntVectorProperty.name: FusePolys
IntVectorProperty.label: Fuse Polys
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Remap polygon cells onto fused points and keep them in the output. Off drops polygons. Degenerate faces with fewer than 3 points are discarded. Triangle strips are used only to define connected components; they are not written to the output.
